# Code of Conduct

Styr is a technical open-source project. Contributions, reviews and discussion should remain professional, specific and respectful.

## Expected behavior

Participants are expected to:

- discuss code, behavior and evidence rather than attacking people;
- accept technical disagreement without turning it into personal conflict;
- give credit for upstream and contributor work;
- avoid harassment, discriminatory language, threats, sexualized attention or deliberate intimidation;
- respect requests to stop unwanted contact;
- keep security reports and other sensitive material in the appropriate private channel.

## Maintainer responsibility

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove comments and contributions that violate these expectations and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation when necessary to protect the project or its contributors. Enforcement decisions should be proportionate to the behavior and its impact.

## Reporting

Conduct concerns should not be opened as public issues when that would expose the people involved. Contact the maintainer at `performer-nx@skjt.de` with the subject `Styr Code of Conduct` and include enough context to evaluate the report.

This project takes the Contributor Covenant 3.0 and GitHub's open-source community guidance as reference points, while keeping this repository policy deliberately concise.
